svg.title: Rejoice Virgin Mother — Tenor 1 and Tenor 2 — Church Slavonic — page 3
svg.desc: Accessible Choral Notation, Tenor 1 and Tenor 2, measures 24–28. Pitch-colored dots are sung; white dots are rests. Full dots are whole beats and semicircles half beats. 12 or 8 ACN beats per measure. Pitch increases vertically from C3 to G+4.
